solution: Users authenticate to individual accounts, with MFA where configured. Accounts belong to role groups. The OS assigns read/write/manage permissions to files/folders and checks the authenticated account’s group permissions on access. Administrator group has management rights;staff can edit teaching files;guest group has only public-folder read rights.

marking_points.criterion: Distinguishes authentication of identity from authorization of permitted operations;MFA is optional rather than required by this prompt.
Administrator and staff permissions correctly differentiated.
Guest denied private files and limited to public folder.
